test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the reported speech.**

He said, “I must stay with her as her condition is critical.”

options.text: He said he would stay with her as her condition is critical.
He said that he has to stay with her as her condition has been critical.
He said that he had to stay with her as her condition was critical.
He said he must stay with her as her condition were critical.

solution:
The correct answer is **"He said that he had to stay with her as her condition was critical".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is being reported in the past tense, so "must"</str
